owner_creation.analysis: build.rs owns the build-time TARGET string. Cargo creates the TARGET String in main; the build script owns that value until its stack scope ends.
owner_creation.invariant: The target value is a Rust-owned String.
limitations: TARGET ownership here excludes any allocation in the pager executable.

aliases_escapes.analysis: build.rs keeps TARGET borrows within main. The comparison and assertion borrow TARGET locally; no reference is returned or written into generated source.
aliases_escapes.invariant: No borrowed TARGET data survives main.
limitations: The TARGET string never crosses the build-script process boundary.

callback_targets.analysis: build.rs emits a linker directive rather than installing a callback. The only invoked interfaces are std::env::var, assert_eq and println; cargo:rustc-link-lib=tinfo is build metadata, not a runtime callback.
callback_targets.invariant: Build metadata stores no function pointers.
limitations: The tinfo linker directive does not establish the runtime provider contract.

invalidation.analysis: build.rs never replaces its TARGET value. The TARGET String is neither replaced nor resized after creation; its borrows end before ordinary Rust drop.
invalidation.invariant: No live pointer is invalidated by replacement.

mutation_commit.analysis: build.rs rejects unsupported targets before linker metadata. The x86_64 GNU/Linux assertion precedes the linker directive, so unsupported targets cannot proceed as a successful supported build.
mutation_commit.invariant: The target check precedes link metadata emission.

release_pair.analysis: build.rs leaves string destruction to Rust. String allocation belongs to std and is released by its destructor; no malloc buffer, file descriptor or tinfo handle is acquired here.
release_pair.invariant: Rust drops the sole temporary allocation.
limitations: String destruction on Rust return is distinct from Cargo process termination.

error_cleanup.analysis: build.rs fails the build before pager startup. Missing TARGET or a mismatched target terminates the build with a diagnostic; unwinding or process exit retains no pager state.
error_cleanup.invariant: Build failure cannot leave runtime pager owners.

signals_handoff.analysis: build.rs executes before pager handlers exist. This program executes in Cargo before the pager exists; it installs no handler and hands no pointer to another process.
signals_handoff.invariant: Cargo sees text, never an owned application pointer.
limitations: This checks the maintained build script; native tinfo provider identity remains a separate runtime obligation.
